description: This file serves as the entry point for a React-based frontend application. It imports React, ReactDOM, a CSS file, and the main App component, then renders the App component inside the DOM element with id 'root' within a React.StrictMode wrapper.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root React node for rendering a React component tree.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders a React element into the DOM at the specified root.
